newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks closed softer in brisk trade.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks closed softer in brisk trade.

text.p: * Toronto stocks ended softer, snapping an eight-day winning streak. * Despite weakness Toronto posted a smaller loss than New York. * 85.4 million shares traded worth C$1.33 billion.
Toronto stocks snapped an eight-day winning streak by closing softer on Monday but managed to contain losses compared to New York.

"Canadian markets are again outperforming the U.S. Thanks, as usual, to the golds, but also, a solid contribution came from financial services, as the Canadian banks head into their Q3 (third quarter) reporting period," said Richardson Greenshields of Canada analyst Dunnery Best in a market report.
Trading was brisk during what is historically one of the quietest weeks of the year.
